name: Orca Whirlpool

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Upgrades look strong (24-hour delay, 5-of-13), but a separate reward authority on the same config is a 1-of-8 multisig with no delay, which scores like a single key. Counting it as full-power is a disclosed judgment call.
narrative.tag: judgment call: reward authority counted as full-power
narrative.detail: WhirlpoolsConfig holds three authorities. fee_authority is the same Squads v4 vault as the program upgrade (5-of-13, 9 can vote, 24h delay). collect_protocol_fees_authority is a bare wallet but only withdraws already accrued fees, so it is bounded and not scored. reward_emissions_super_authority is a different Squads v4 vault, 1-of-8, no delay. It can reassign the reward authority of any pool without that pool's consent, and that authority can set the pool's emission rate. A reviewer could argue it is bounded, and the scorer lays out the reasoning. DefiLlama listed over $200M TVL on 2026-09-17.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it

independent_read.disagree: the score says one key does everything (5), the upgrade authority is a Squads v4 via account owned by program whirLbMi… -> program -> ProgramData CtXfPz… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly) -> Squads v4 vault 0 of multisig BQsDWkL417U4tVE2sDnPks469pKdm6YzFgKH77doiEjF; the multisig score says no real multisig (0), the Squads multisig is a 5-of-13; the timelock score says no delay (0), the Squads multisig enforces a native time lock of 24 h
